items.title: LME aluminium and SHFE aluminium see slight recovery; demand under pressure amid the tail end of peak season, with mixed bullish and bearish factors
items.description: Aluminium prices rebound as bearish momentum eases, but weaker demand and slower destocking keep further gains in check.

items.title: NALCO Q2 net sales rise 26.2% to Rs 5,380 crore; alumina exports fall 16.4% YoY
items.description: NALCO's Q2 FY27 net sales rose 26.2% year on year, driven by stronger aluminium sales and higher LME prices, while alumina exports fell.

items.title: LME Aluminium Slips While Energy Costs and Smelter Margins Remain in Focus
Yunnan Aluminium Earnings Jump 164% as Revenue Rises Just 19%
items.description: LME aluminium averaged about US$3,382/t in H1 2026, up 31.9% year-on-year, according to China Hongqiao.

items.title: Renewed rate hike expectations weigh on futures, weakening marginal demand is holding back the recovery in aluminium prices
items.description: Aluminium prices face consolidation as mixed macro signals, slower inventory declines and weak demand limit a recovery.

items.title: Alba marks a decade of summer safety excellence with zero heat-related injuries and illnesses
items.description: Aluminium Bahrain B.S.C. (Alba), one of the world's largest aluminium smelters, completed its 10th consecutive summer safety campaign.

items.title: Cable installation begins in Lake Veere for Dutch offshore wind connections
items.description: Prysmian and Deme have started installing high-voltage cables on the bed of Lake Veere in Zeeland, the Netherlands, for grid operator TenneT.

items.title: Fed rate hike expectations are easing, as aluminium price technical rebound gains momentum
items.description: Aluminium futures rally as easing rate hike fears and falling Chinese inventories support prices despite supply concerns.

items.title: Alba at LME Week 2026: CEO Ali Al Baqali strengthens global aluminium industry ties
items.description: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba) strengthened its engagement with the global aluminium and metals industry at LME Week.

items.title: EWA leads August contract awards in Bahrain
items.description: EWA led Bahrain's August Official Gazette awards, headed by Iljin Electric's Sitra feeder cable works and Hitachi Energy's substation transformers.

items.title: Taihan Cable & Solution secures U.S. ultra-high-voltage power grid project
items.description: Taihan will supply 120 billion won in cables for a turnkey ultra-high-voltage grid project in the United States.

items.title: Egypt's Elsewedy Electric, China's Sinohydro sign $2.2bn Saudi power plant contract
items.description: A consortium of Egypt's Elsewedy Electric and China's Sinohydro has secured a $2.2 billion contract to expand Saudi Arabia's Rabigh 2 independent power plant.

items.title: Acciona awarded $455m contract for WA's Clean Energy Link – East project
items.description: Acciona will deliver a significant component of the Clean Energy Link – East transmission project in Western Australia, valued at A$655m.

items.title: Alba connects with the global aluminium industry at ALUMINIUM 2026
items.description: Aluminium Bahrain is owned by Bahrain Mumtalakat (69.38%), Ma'aden (20.62%) and the public (10%).

items.title: L&T secures mega power transmission orders in Saudi Arabia, UAE and India
items.description: L&T secures EPC orders across Saudi Arabia, UAE and India, including 380 kV transmission and substation projects in Saudi Arabia to support grid expansion.
